main_body: Wooden pulpit box with a red cloth panel and gold cross on its front, plus a small staircase on the right
top_band: Orange top at rows 13-14 (L≈157), then rows 15-16 fading darker (L 130 to 101) into the dark frame. It reads as roughly 2-3 rows of top surface, with no distinct front-edge step.
evidence: The pulpit body is a face-on elevation. A 2-3 row orange cap sits over a 25-row front that holds a framed red panel. At x=33 the cap just darkens into the front with no distinct front-edge line, so it works as a hat on a front elevation, not a real top surface (compare the guide's 5-row cabinet top). The staircase on the right is a side profile. Its steps have only 2-3 row cream treads over flat tan risers, and it has a diagonal rail, so it is a side elevation. A mixed drawing fails if any major part is wrong.

style.evidence: Outlines are tinted dark brown (0% neutral edge pixels), which fits the standard. Shading is shallower than the references: wood has about 4 steps and the stair blocks about 3. The red cloth panel and the stair risers are large flat fills, and flat-fill coverage is 18% against 13% and 0% for the references. Distinct colours (32) and colours per tile (13) are below both references (40/38 and 17/20). It looks thinner and flatter than the Beodeul pieces.
